bluf: Boostability is a Lehi, UT SEO reseller for small businesses, private equity backed through H.I.G. Capital on an Oct 2014 investment, current stake unconfirmed, selling AI ready SEO direct to SMBs and white label through agency resellers. The record shows it refining its Be Found Framework in May 2026 for visibility in AI retrieval, running 50 Google ads with 9 in the last 30 days, and publishing nothing: 0 sitemap URLs updated in 365 days. Horus reads Neutral at 1.8; Monsoon reads Landfall at 90.2 with displacement 98.8. What a rival should know: the book buys on price, the record names one client, and the whole offer is movable hours.

The positioning line, AI ready SEO sold to small businesses directly and through agency resellers via a white label program it ranks first worldwide, decodes as a wholesale SEO factory: the reseller channel is the business. The headline claim, that its white label SEO partner program is the global leader, comes with no evidence in the record beyond its own site.

AI Search / GEO scores 2, core, on the May 2026 refinement of the Be Found Framework for SMB visibility in AI retrieval. Local scores 2, core, on the white label local SEO line for agency resellers. Content & Digital PR scores 1; everything else 0. The one proprietary product is the Be Found Framework, BFF; the record lists no partners.

Its AI posture is a repackaging: it markets AI ready SEO and aims the BFF refinement at AI retrieval, but the Horus P1 read is partial because no audited AI visibility product shows in the record.

The only dated move is May 2026, the BFF refinement. The prior record carries an Inc. 5000 honour in 2021. News, case studies and jobs are empty. The employee figure, 315, is a third party database estimate, the archived homepage was unreadable, and the active status rests on the prior record and its own Google ads running through 2026-09-27; confidence is low.

The record lists no pricing model, conspicuous for a program sold to resellers. Also absent for a company of its kind: any measurement line, any paid search or LSA work beside the local line, any case study beyond the one whose slug names a COVID 19 study, and any content published in the last 365 days.
